migration.note: Test8 proved the static/player-page resolver still did not reach a true direct media URL and introduced a new performance regression by synchronously chasing several player pages while rendering detail. Test9 removes all multi-hop network work from detail render; one detail request only. Playback uses direct media present in current HTML when available, otherwise targets the detected player/iframe page with webRule for fast video/currentSrc/resource capture. Pure API no-sniff remains a separate protocol-research target and is not falsely claimed as complete.
